summary: Stacks children in a column with a gap from the space scale. The default gap follows density (16px comfortable, 12px compact).
whenToUse: Vertical rhythm inside cards, dialogs, forms and page sections.
gap from the space scale: tight (1 to 2) inside a group, generous (6 to 8) between groups.
render to output a semantic element: <section />, <ul />, <form />.
whenNotToUse: Two-dimensional layouts with columns: use Grid.
Spacing one element only: give that element a margin class in your app, not a wrapper.

dos.title: Nest stacks to show grouping
dos.text: A tight stack per group inside a looser stack: the space itself says what belongs together.

donts.title: One gap for everything
donts.text: Equal spacing everywhere flattens hierarchy. Vary the gap to separate groups.

accessibility: A plain div by default with no role: it changes layout, not semantics.
Use render to give the stack the right element (a list of items should be <ul />).
Visual order equals DOM order, so reading and tab order stay consistent.
contentGuidelines: Not applicable: Stack holds no copy of its own.
